g.title: {"@rid": "#420:124", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Vipadika or Vaipadika is explained as one among Eleven Kshudra Kushtas (Minor skin ailments) which has the features of Paanipaada sputana (Cracking of palms and soles) associated with Teevravedana (Intense pain) as explained by Acharya Charaka.", "name": "Vipadika", "id": "826"}

{"@rid": "#440:252", "@type": "Formulation", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Ingredients of Tab Sutshekhar ras are Parad (Mercury), Gandhak (Sulfur), Dhatura (Datura metel), Shankh Bhasma (Conch shell ash, primarily calcium based compounds), Vatsanabha (Aconitum ferox or Aconitum napellus), Trikatu (a combination of Zingiber officinale - ginger, Piper nigrum - black pepper, and Piper longum - long pepper), Chaturjat (a blend of Cinnamomum zeylanicum - cinnamon, Cinnamomum tamala - Indian bay leaf, Elettaria cardamomum-cardamom, and Caryophyllus aromaticus - clove), Tankan Bhasma (Borax ash, Sodium borate), and Tamra Bhasma (Copper ash).", "name": "Sutshekhar Rasa", "id": "1863"}

{"@rid": "#440:293", "@type": "Formulation", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Trivrit Kashaya: 100 mL, Trivrit Churna: 25 g, Sugar: 50 g, Honey: 25 mL, Cinnamon: 5 g, Cardamom: 5 g, Cinnamon leaves powder: 5 g", "name": "Trivrit Lehyam", "id": "1904"}

{"@rid": "#440:31", "@type": "Formulation", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A medicated ghee with chief ingredients Saptaparna (Alstonia scholaris (L.) R.Br.), Aragvadha (Withania somnifera (L.)
